scientific.integrity: The claim separates prior scalar and special-case counting results from the retained arbitrary-part all-set classification, supplies a direct proof from the standard witness definition, and cross-checks the formula by exhaustive computation through order 10.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite verifier covers orders through 10; arbitrary order is justified by the symbolic proof.
The complete-multipartite scalar super domination number is prior-covered and is not claimed as new.
Published enumeration for complete graphs, stars, and complete bipartite graphs is treated as prior-covered special-case information.
A poorly indexed equivalent all-set classification under alternate terminology remains a residual literature risk.

title: All super dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
